data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Tempest Island Flares; Fishermans Row Still in Heavy Fight
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the last edition, Tempest Island has flared into action, a strategic base changing hands shortly after 1 a.m. Stema Landing likewise remains unsettled, its latest move logged at 11:52 p.m. Fishermans Row still dominates the base board with twenty-three recorded changes over the past day, though the last two hours have been quiet there. DeadLands, carrying fourteen daily changes, has gone still since 7 p.m. Godcrofts broke its calm with a fresh event at 11:25 p.m., while Lykos Isle has seen five shifts, the latest near 10 p.m. Farranac Coast has not stirred since 5:50 p.m., and Linn Mercy remains dormant. Clahstra and Weathered Expanse continue to pile up casualties without any strategic bases changing hands. The war enters its eighty-third day with the ledger still split and neither side at the required victory total.
